invented.quote: These are the foods our families value most and the hardest for us to handle, because we have no way to transport or hold them cold.
invented.why: The brief does not state which foods the families value most, nor does it state that the food bank currently has no way at all to transport or hold cold food (despite currently handing out 6,000 pounds of it monthly).

invented.quote: We had willing donors and families who needed it, and the only thing missing was a cold vehicle.
invented.why: The brief states the food was turned down because the food bank had no way to pick it up cold or store it, so a vehicle was not the only thing missing.

invented.quote: The van will let us collect produce, dairy and eggs directly from local farms and keep them cold until distribution.
invented.why: The brief only mentions that local farms offered produce, not dairy and eggs, and does not state that the van will be used as cold storage until distribution.
